newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soybeans limit-down on Brazilian soy imports.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soybeans limit-down on Brazilian soy imports.

text.p: CBOT July soybeans fell the 30-cent daily trading limit Wednesday in response to confirmation that at least one U.S. firm was importing Brazilian soybeans, traders said.
"Its definitely taking some premium out of the cash and futures markets," one trader said.
Cargill Inc said Wednesday it was contracting to import an unspecified quantity of soybeans from Brazil.
At 1224 CDT, soybeans were down 26 cents to 1-1/2 cent per bushel, with July down 26 at $8.32 per bushel.
